--- zerops-project-import.yml ---
project:
  name: zeroops-app
  services:
    - name: postgres
      type: postgresql@16
      mode: HA
    - name: valkey
      type: valkey@7
      mode: HA
    - name: frontend
      type: nodejs@20
      mode: NON_HA
    - name: api
      type: go@1.22
      mode: NON_HA
    - name: worker
      type: python@3.11
      mode: NON_HA


--- zerops.yml ---
zerops:
  - setup: frontend
    build:
      base: nodejs@20
      os: ubuntu
      buildCommands:
        - npm ci
        - npm run build
      deployFiles:
        - .
    deploy:
      readinessCheck:
        httpGet:
          path: /
          port: 3000
    run:
      base: nodejs@20
      os: ubuntu
      ports:
        - port: 3000
          protocol: TCP
          httpSupport: true
      start: npm start
      envVariables:
        PORT: '3000'
        NODE_ENV: production
        DB_HOST: postgres
        DB_PORT: '5432'
        DB_USER: zerops
        DB_PASSWORD: zerops_secure_pass_2026
        DB_NAME: zeroops_db
        DATABASE_URL: postgres://zerops:zerops_secure_pass_2026@postgres:5432/zeroops_db
        VALKEY_HOST: valkey
        VALKEY_PORT: '6379'
        REDIS_URL: redis://valkey:6379
        API_HOST: api
        API_PORT: '8080'
        API_URL: http://api:8080
  - setup: api
    build:
      base: go@1.22

        - .
